content:
maria: Quick UX flag — when you open the table inside the small narrow modal the rightmost column with the action menu gets clipped, see screenshot: https://img.redwood/shots/1234 :warning:

alex: can repro on Chrome 120. If you make the modal narrower the kebab menu disappears off-canvas, not just visually but unclickable.

joel: also seeing keyboard issue — tabbing to the row actions sometimes skips entirely (focus goes to modal footer). probable focus trap + overflow problem. :thinking_face:

samira: hmm could be z-index and overflow:hidden on the modal body. Our toasts have high z-index so might be interfering too.

maria: here's the quick repro CSS I used in dev tools:
```css
.modal-body { overflow: hidden; }
.table td .menu { position: absolute; right: 8px; z-index: 100; }
```
If you change .modal-body to overflow: visible the menu reappears but that has layout ramifications.

alex: interesting — I think the menu is positioned relative to the table cell which is inside a clipping container. We either need a portal for the menu or adjust modal internals. Portaling would keep it out of clipping and preserve focus.

joel: portaling is fine but we need to ensure keyboard focus order remains predictable. Portal + focus trap means we must programmatically move focus into the portal element when menu opens, and return it after close. Otherwise screen reader users get lost.

samira: also noticed the spacing token used around the action cell is compact-xl which leaves little room for the menu icon. If we use spacing token spacing-2 at the cell edge it might reduce overlap. small spacing tweak could be lower-risk than structural change.

maria: agree — quick win: increase right-side padding on the action column to spacing-2, fallback to portal for long-term. I'll propose in PR.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: ensure menu items have role="menu" and each item role="menuitem"; add aria-expanded on the trigger and aria-controls linking to the popup. Keyboard: Up/Down to navigate, Esc to close.

alex: For toasts, FYI I saw a case where a toast appears and forces the menu off-screen because it reflows the layout. Toasts should be absolutely positioned outside modal content flow. We're currently using relative positioning in the console.

joel: Good catch. Action list for this thread:
- maria: open GH issue with screenshots + minimal repro + proposed spacing token change (spacing-2) — owner: maria.
- alex: prototype portaled menu with focus management, try to keep markup ARIA-friendly.
- samira: audit spacing tokens around table cells and suggest token variants for compact modals.
- joel: write a11y checklist for portaled menus inside modals and validate with VO.

maria: filing issue now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/issues/4234 — added screenshots and steps. I'll start the spacing PR today. :sparkles:

samira: optional: if we add a modifier token like --action-padding-sm we can keep default while allowing tighter rows in dense lists.

alex: I'll try a quick prototype by EOD and post a short recording.

joel: thanks team. marking this as high priority for console 2.1 since it affects actionability in compact overlays.

maria: will follow up with PR link and QA steps. Thanks all :thumbsup:
